title: Member progress
text: In Shipping and Runs history, a shared run appears when it carries work from a project you can see. Its member records, item QA and bound sources follow your project access. Shipping cards and deployment run detail show current applicable member obligations before copies or attempts exist. Matching deployment copies supply release-specific proof; waived obligations stay explicit and completed releases preserve frozen definitions. Authorized takeover transfers open members and their private/shared QA without discarding pass/fail evidence or unfinished execution state. Closed members retain delivery history; the current owner still owes its own delivery gates.
